versions.changelog: Fix security-flagged language in skill docs.
Add AgentMail as alternative email provider. Dedicated vendor-scoped inbox, no OAuth. Human approves inbox address during pairing.

Add AgentMail as alternative email provider. Submit all inbox messages (no vendor filtering). Unknown vendors get queued and added to allowlist via 202 flow. Fix API field shapes. Remove raw HTTP patterns.
Declare CRINKL_API_KEY credential in registry metadata. Describes pairing flow, agent-memory storage, and revocability. Addresses scanner inconsistency flag.
Remove shell command patterns from HEARTBEAT.md. Add domain validation after vendor fetch. Gmail queries are now API data strings, not CLI commands. Addresses command injection scanner flag.

Declare crinkl MCP server dependency (requires.mcp). Replace all raw HTTP calls with declared MCP tool names (submit-receipt, verify-receipt, get-vendors, pair-agent, claim-api-key, get-agent-me). Should resolve suspicious code insights classification.
Rewrite description for discoverability (benefit-first, search keywords, crinkl.xyz URL). Fix vendor examples. Add install command. Expand trigger words.
Remove metadata inconsistencies, simplify to single verified gmail path (gog), tighten privacy section.
Verify billing emails via DKIM signatures, earn BTC over Lightning. Device pairing flow — agent self-pairs with 4-char code. Works with gog, gmail, or any email skill.
